```{r}
library(readr)
taxa_raw <- read_tsv("MM_metaphlan4vOct22_infantis_final_2026.txt")
taxa_raw<- as.data.frame(taxa_raw)
row.names(taxa_raw) <-taxa_raw$NG_ID
KN <- read_tsv("MM_KN_stats_final_2026.txt")
KN<- as.data.frame(KN)
row.names(KN) <-KN$KN_ID
check <- KN [grep("^B", rownames(KN)), ]
KN$KN_ID=NULL
```

```{r}

options(scipen = 999)
sel <- grepl("^B", rownames(KN))

png("histogram_clean_reads_P1.png", width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)

hist(
  KN$Clean_reads_P1[sel],
  breaks = 350,
  main = "Histogram of Clean Reads",
  xlab = "Clean Reads",
  col = "steelblue",
  border = "white",
  xaxt = "n"
)
axis(
  side = 1,
  at = pretty(KN$Clean_reads_P1[sel], n = 10),
  labels = format(
    pretty(KN$Clean_reads_P1[sel], n = 10),
    scientific = FALSE,
    big.mark = ","
  )
)

dev.off()

cutoff <- 3000000
sel <- grepl("^B", rownames(KN))
sum(KN$Clean_reads_P1[sel] > cutoff, na.rm = TRUE)

```

```{r}
library(plotly)
library(ggplot2)

KN$ID <- rownames(KN)

p <- ggplot(KN, aes(x = Clean_reads_P1, text = paste0("ID: ", ID, "<br>Clean_reads_P1: ", Clean_reads_P1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 350)

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
```

```{r}
# bring Clean_reads_P1 into taxa_raw
rownames(taxa_raw)[rownames(taxa_raw) == "M200_00_4B08"] <- "P200_00_4B08"
rownames(KN)[rownames(KN) == "M200_00_4B08"] <- "P200_00_4B08"
taxa_raw$Clean_reads_P1 <- KN[rownames(taxa_raw), "Clean_reads_P1"]

# check for missing matches
sum(is.na(taxa_raw$Clean_reads_P1))

median(taxa_raw$Clean_reads_P1)

# keep only samples with >3M reads
taxa_raw_filt <- taxa_raw[
  taxa_raw$Clean_reads_P1 > 3000000 | rownames(taxa_raw) == "N300_00_11A7",
]

# remove the column afterwards
taxa_raw_filt$Clean_reads_P1 <- NULL

taxa=taxa_raw_filt

#rename probiotics
rename_map <- c(
  "MG10BOMPC1_Z" = "P300_00_13H1",
  "MG10BOMPC2_Z" = "P300_00_13H2"
)
rn <- rownames(taxa)
rn[rn %in% names(rename_map)] <- rename_map[rn[rn %in% names(rename_map)]]
rownames(taxa) <- rn
taxa$NG_ID[taxa$NG_ID %in% names(rename_map)] <-
  rename_map[taxa$NG_ID[taxa$NG_ID %in% names(rename_map)]]
```

```{r}
#Remove empty tubes
remove_dupl <- c(
  "B013_28_1G01", "B026_04_5G07", "B041_21_1B09",
  "B136_02_11D6", "M043_00_6B01")
taxa <- taxa[!(rownames(taxa) %in% remove_dupl), ]

#remove duplicate samples
remove_duplicate <- c("B116_03_12B2","M056_00_4A08", "M056_00_6F05")
taxa <- taxa[!(rownames(taxa) %in% remove_duplicate), ]

#Remove samples outside the ellipse (potential sample mix-up)
remove_outside_ellipse <- c("B001_04_4C08", "B011_31_5F04", "B017_04_5F05", "B071_04_7B01", "B072_15_7H01", "B075_05_7F02", "B075_08_7G02", "B085_03_7B07", "B157_07_10F7", "M009_00_5C03", "M088_00_7F08", "M200_00_4B08")
taxa <- taxa[!(rownames(taxa) %in% remove_outside_ellipse), ]

remove_meconium <- c("B080_04_7D05", "B118_03_9A01","B134_04_9D08","B045_04_6C01")

taxa <- taxa[!(rownames(taxa) %in% remove_meconium), ]
```
